title: Ten-item comparison balanced sampling policy
algorithm: Build the same layer/weirdness-filtered pools used by the public UI.
Classify DNA readings by membership in recursivePool().
Sample each stratum without replacement and without duplicating a reading already selected from another stratum.
Shuffle the selected ten so strata are not shown in fixed blocks.
If a stratum is short, fill from the combined unused public comparison pool.
invariants: At least ten available readings still produce ten unique comparison items.
No public candidate is removed from inventory.
L2 and L3 comparison behavior is unchanged.
Bridge candidates remain part of seam-and-bridge.
